name: Two-Weapon Warrior
summary: A paired-weapon specialist who trades armor and weapon training for a defensive flurry, paired strikes, and perfect balance.

features.name: Defensive Flurry +1
features.summary: After a full attack with both weapons, gain +1 dodge AC against melee attacks until your next turn.

features.name: Defensive Flurry +2
features.summary: After a full attack with both weapons, gain +2 dodge AC against melee attacks until your next turn.

features.name: Improved Balance
features.summary: Reduce two-weapon attack penalties by 1, or treat a one-handed off-hand weapon as light.

features.name: Perfect Balance
features.summary: Reduce two-weapon attack penalties by another 1; this stacks with Improved Balance.

features.name: Twin Blades +1
features.summary: Gain +1 on attack and damage rolls during a full attack with two weapons or a double weapon.

features.name: Doublestrike
features.summary: As a standard action, attack once with both your primary and secondary weapons, applying normal two-weapon penalties.

features.name: Twin Blades +2
features.summary: Gain +2 on attack and damage rolls during a full attack with two weapons or a double weapon.

features.name: Equal Opportunity
features.summary: When making an attack of opportunity, attack once with both your primary and secondary weapons.

features.name: Twin Blades +3
features.summary: Gain +3 on attack and damage rolls during a full attack with two weapons or a double weapon.

features.name: Deft Doublestrike
features.summary: After hitting one opponent with both weapons, immediately make a non-provoking disarm, sunder, or eligible trip attempt.

features.name: Twin Blades +4
features.summary: Gain +4 on attack and damage rolls during a full attack with two weapons or a double weapon.

features.name: Deadly Defense
features.summary: After a full attack with both weapons, each creature that hits you in melee before your next turn provokes an attack of opportunity from you.
